descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper masculine name (מִישָׁאֵל) meaning 'who is what God is?', referring to three biblical figures: (1) a son of Uzziel son of Kohath, cousin of Moses and Aaron who carried the bodies of Nadab and Abihu (Exod 6:22; Lev 10:4), (2) one who stood with Ezra at the reading of the Law (Neh 8:4), and (3) the Hebrew name of Meshach, one of Daniel's three companions (Dan 1:6-7,11,19; 2:17). Multilingual evidence: eng 'Mishael', spa 'Mishael/Misael', arb 'مِيشَائِيل', kor '미사엘/미샤엘', swa 'Mishaeli'. The conjunctive forms (S111298) are grammatical variants of the same proper noun as the standalone form (S111297).
